reviews.text: We’ve been bringing our dog Antonio here for a while, and we’ve always received excellent care. The other day, we had an emergency and they were able to fit us in the same day, which we really appreciated. The team has always been very clear in their communication, patient with our questions, and genuinely caring toward Antonio. It’s reassuring to know we can count on them when we need help. Highly recommend!

Jane animal hospital is a fantastic veterinarian clinic.  From the front staff to the wonderful vet techs to the veterinarians
Every step of the way, they are caring and very good at diagnosing the problem.
I highly recommend this clinic
My dog loves it there!

I am truly disappointed and upset. I brought my kitten in for an emergency—this has been his regular veterinary clinic—because he is very ill, yet they refused to treat him simply because I hadn't made an appointment days in advance. How was I supposed to know my kitten would get sick? It is a complete lack of ethics; their job is supposed to be saving animals' lives. I had entrusted this clinic with my kitten's health since he was little, but never again—such a lack of sensitivity toward the lives of animals.

Very friendly Vets. They triple show they care for the pets. They don’t push unnecessary costs on you. They advise honestly and with compassion. We never leave with the feeling we are overpaying. The only thing I would say that booking surgeries in advance is challenging as they only plan a month in advance. But if you flexible then that’s ok.
Very friendly staff that take time to listen to your concerns and try to help. They always take good care of my big boy and for that I am great full
Even though they’re not an emergency hospital they help me so much wit my boy, he stepped on tar because negligence and he well taking care of!!

I've only visited this vet once so far for my cats' annual checkups, and that experience was good; The vet was professional and made good suggestions for improving their quality of life and avoiding repeats of past health issues.

Where I'm really grateful is how they handle questions that I'm not sure about. They're always willing to look at photos via email, and will get one of the medical staff to follow up with recommendations. Including whether or not the current situation warrants a visit. It saves everyone time, and leaves appointments for the animals who really need them. It's a really great system.

They're a little more expensive than other vets in the area, as of late 2025 when I checked, but absolutely worth it in my opinion. Thanks again Jane Animal Hospital!
Thanks for the fantastic rating, Dimitra! We strive to make every visit a 5-star experience.

I brought my cat to see Dr. Rachael for check-up and vaccination today. Kitty attended under protest. She has a strong personality, and she made sure everyone in the room knew it. Dr. Rachael was completely unfazed by Kitty’s dramatic performance - calm, patient, and incredibly professional throughout. She was thorough and answered all my questions, making me feel confident about her health. She focused on what mattered, not on what costs more - and I truly appreciate that. Highly recommended the clinic and Dr. Rachael ! ❤️
Thank you for the 5 stars! We strive to provide excellent service and are glad you had a positive experience.

Only great things to say about this clinic. They took amazing care of our sweet kitty and were always very kind, thorough, and communicative in their approach.

Update March 2026:

I would give more than five stars if I could! One of my cats recently had extensive dental surgery at Jane Animal Hospital and it was as positive an experience as such a procedure can be. I really wanted to reiterate how wonderful all the staff are - from the front desk staff to the techs and the vets, everyone is extremely kind and caring.

Original review:

I recently adopted two rescue cats and brought them to Jane Animal Hospital for their annual wellness exam and vaccinations, and I am so glad I did!

Everyone from the receptionists to the vet techs to the vets are absolutely amazing. I had a few phone conversations before the appointment because my cats become extremely stressed when handled and the team at JAH provided me with advice regarding sedation.

During the appointment, the staff were absolute pros at examining my *very* frightened girls. The appointment was seamless and I am so glad I found such a great team to care for my cats!

While we usually go to the “sister” clinic, we needed a last minute appointment on Monday morning.   Bella was so helpful, and got us in for 9 am.   Dr. Atkinson and Sarah saw Lucy almost right away.  Dr. Atkinson had treated Lucy previously, and was once again very helpful and reassuring.   This was such a good experience.

Our dog duke is a rescue and has a fear of males. This clinic is practically all female and it’s the best vet i’ve ever been to! They truly care and love all the animals, and we completely trust them. Dr. Roque in particular is phenomenal. :) She did our dogs amputation surgery and you can really tell it was done with care and love!
Thank you for the 5 stars, Caroline. We're so glad we exceeded your expectations.

Nothing but good things to say about Jane Animal Hospital, a top notch outfit from start to finish. Our dog had a specific medical issue that could have rapidly become very serious, but a fast response from multiple vets, including a great effort over the holiday season, got things under control. Reception staff and technicians are very professional and helpful, and it's apparent that everyone here went into the veterinary field out of a passion for animals.

Treats my babies so well!! Staff super friendly and informational. I go to get my puppy’s nails cut and they do a great job getting really short! And I’m happy I’ve been able to just send pictures and ask questions through email and the vet will call me to discuss!! Thank you guys 💓

UPDATED REVIEW (2025)

I’ve been extremely disappointed with the lack of communication and overall care at Jane Animal Hospital over the past year. We have been bringing our pets here for years and always stayed consistent with annual appointments, but my recent experience has made me completely lose confidence in this clinic.

My cat broke a tooth and we proceeded with pre-operation testing. I was told his blood work looked like that of a 10–12-year-old cat (he is FOUR), and that it suggested stage 4 kidney issues but “more testing was needed.” I brought him in for additional analysis—which I had to medicate him for—only to find out afterwards that they never ran a UPCR test, which after my own research is essential for diagnosing kidney disease. I was told they “usually only do it on senior cats,” which makes zero sense considering they were already concerned about kidney function.

They also admitted that his bloodwork and urinalysis should have been re-done in 2023, but I was never notified. Every single annual visit I mentioned his urinary issues and not once did anyone recommend further testing, early kidney staging, or dietary changes that could have helped years earlier. The clinic never guided us on preventative care, diet, or lifestyle adjustments despite having his previous results (which they told me afterwards that he was already at stage 2 and I never knew that).

I took him to a second veterinarian for another opinion. This vet immediately diagnosed him with feline tooth resorption, which Jane Animal Hospital completely missed. Jane Animal hospital suggested running the UPCR at the same time as his dental procedure, but because the tooth resorption was overlooked, it would have meant either my cat being under anesthesia for significantly longer, or needing two separate surgical dates. Both are higher risk for kidney issue cats and completely avoidable if Jane Animal Hospital had done their job.

On top of that, it took over two months to get a prescription filled for my dog, which forced me to buy the medication directly from the clinic in the meantime. This felt extremely unprofessional and put me in a situation where I had no choice but to pay their prices because they wouldn’t approve the script in a timely manner.

I am extremely disappointed in the lack of communication, missed diagnoses, inconsistent medical recommendations, and reactive—not proactive care. It’s heartbreaking to think that my cat has had kidney issues  present for years and we were never informed or guided properly, even while paying for annual checkups. The oversight on the tooth resorption alone could have put his health at serious risk.

We have used the Jane Animal Hospital for several cats and a variety of services over several decades. We continue to be happy with their service, facilities, and convenience. The original owners and staff were consistently outstanding during the 1990s and 2000s. Then the ownership and staff changed around the time of the COVID pandemic—like many services for pets. The clinic is seemingly now operated by a corporation in conjunction with Richview Hospital (about 10 minutes drive north, and perhaps other facilities?) rather than as an independent business.  At our most recent visit (in September 2025) the staff (receptionist, technician, and veterinarian) were each efficient, informed, and helpful.  We had been less pleased with some staff in previous, recent years, but none of those folks were around now.
The kindest, most sweetest team ❤️  They are literally angels.

I never had the chance to thank you for taking care of me and my health all these years.

Royce 🌹

I was overwhelmed by her kindness, compassion and obvious care she has for the pets in our west end community.  I know my pup is in great hands at Jane Animal Hospital.

Edited response: I want to also emphasize how good the staff in the front office are. Our dog had a huge tick on her eye this morning and we were accommodated so promptly. By Jess + looked after.
